**Upgrade:** `npm install create-modern-cmdk@1.4.1` · **Breaking:** none · **Deprecated:** none new

create-modern-cmdk 1.4.1 makes the `react-dialog` template open on the key its text names and prints the next steps for your package manager.

### Before you upgrade

- Nothing to do.

### Highlights

- The `react-dialog` template opens and closes on `Mod+K`, which is Cmd+K on Apple platforms and Ctrl+K elsewhere, and works with Caps Lock on. [Getting started](https://abcrimson.github.io/modern-cmdk/guide/getting-started.html)
- The next steps print the install and dev commands of npm, pnpm, yarn or bun, whichever ran the scaffolder. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-modern-cmdk)
- `--help` describes the `react-dialog` shortcut per platform. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-modern-cmdk)
- The README, description, keywords and homepage describe what the scaffolder writes and prints. [Getting started](https://abcrimson.github.io/modern-cmdk/guide/getting-started.html)
